decisions.statement: A page states no value for a property whose declaration fixes one.
A page stating one is refused rather than read as agreeing.
A fixed value is not a default.
A declaration fixing a value states no default.
A required property with a fixed value is on every page of the type.
An optional property with a fixed value is on a page or is not.
A fixed value is written as text whatever kind its property holds.

definition: the value every page of a type has for a property, stated by none of them
